templates_dialog_description: A template = a name + a Docker image already on the host. Registering is configuration — the image can be built later; if it is missing, sandbox creation fails with an error naming it.
templates_update_success: Template "{name}" → {image} — sandboxes still on the old image show an "upgradable" tag in the list; rebuild them one by one
templates_field_name_hint: Also the E2B templateID; "base" is reserved and always points to the base image.
templates_field_image_hint: An image reference in the host's Docker. Re-registering the same name = pointing it at a new image = a template upgrade.
templates_remove_absent: "{name}" did not exist in the first place
templates_remove_description: Only the registration is deleted; the image itself is untouched. If sandboxes still reference it, the daemon refuses and names them.
templates_empty_description: Without templates every sandbox uses the daemon's base image. Build an image on the host, then give it a name here.
